newsitem.title: USA: LaserSight stake held by investor.
newsitem.headline: LaserSight stake held by investor.

text.p: James Vaughan, a Maryland Heights, Mo., investor said Tuesday he holds a 5.6 percent stake in LaserSight Inc, or 461,725 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Vaughan said his latest transactions include the purchase of 100,000 common shares between October 16 and November 27 at prices ranging from $5.3750 to $6 per share.
The Orlando, Fla., company develops, manufacturers and markets optical materials, electrical components and laser systems for research, medical and industrial applications.
